ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominant low-intensity dark skin (estimated 85-90% of visible fluke area) contrasted against high-intensity white scarring and water droplets (10-15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white circular mottling and focal spots are distributed across the dark ventral surface, with high-density clustering observed at the distal tips of both lobes and a randomized dispersion in the medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge displays a highly irregular topography with high-frequency serrations across the span. Massive, irregular high-amplitude protrusions are present at the distal lobe tips, disrupting the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobe trailing edges exhibit a distinctly concave sweep trajectory moving distally from the central fluke area.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed clusters of circular white high-contrast pixel groups (rosettes) are localized throughout the ventral surface, particularly concentrated on the distal half of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions are visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge topography.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, dark, irregular masses representing barnacle colonization are present at the extreme tips of both lobes. Extensive circular white scarring (barnacle attachment marks) is visible across the ventral skin.
other_distinctive_markers: The fluke tips exhibit extreme morphological irregularity and increased pixel-depth due to the presence of large sessile organism clusters.
